# Changelog

All notable changes to `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder` are documented here.
Format based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/),
versioning follows [SemVer](https://semver.org/).

## [2.0.2](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.0.1...2.0.2) - 2026-09-08

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Official v2 packages move to `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder` and
  `@ficsysfr/jsonforms_builder-mcp`. Public exports, the MCP binary name and the historical builder
  draft key stay unchanged; only installation and import paths change.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Added blocking TypeScript validation and corrected TipTap `NodeView`, invalid UI-schema input,
  JSON Schema `allOf` accumulation and non-textual date-format handling (`aca301d`).

### 📝 Documentation

- Moved canonical repository, Pages, Codecov and contributor links to FicSysFR (`8922fb4`).
- Updated installation, Tailwind, Vite and MCP examples for the `@ficsysfr` scope.

### 🔧 Internal

- Added audited npm tarballs, checksums, versioned changelog sources and one idempotent release
  workflow using npm Trusted Publishing provenance.
- The one-use bootstrap run freezes the former `@tacxou` v2 packages only after both FicSysFR
  packages have passed registry integrity and dist-tag verification.

## [2.0.1](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/2.0.0...2.0.1) - 2026-08-11

### 🔧 Internal

- Synchronized the library and MCP package versions for publication (`7864b28`).

## [2.0.0](https://github.com/FicSysFR/jsonforms_builder/compare/1.0.3...2.0.0) - 2026-08-11

Complete stack change: the renderers no longer build on Quasar but on
**Nuxt UI 4 + Tailwind CSS 4**, and therefore inherit the host application's theme automatically.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Renderers rewritten on the Nuxt UI `U*` components: `nuxtUiRenderers` and `allRenderers` replace
  the Quasar entry points (`c3a864d`).
- `@nuxt/ui` becomes a peer dependency alongside Vue and JSON Forms (`c3a864d`).
- Tailwind 4 consumers must include the package's `dist` directory as a source (`c3a864d`).
- v1 remains available from the `v1-quasar` branch and `@tacxou/jsonforms_builder@1.x`.

### ✨ Features

- Added the visual schema/UI-schema builder with draft persistence and JSON export (`b7deded`,
  `586c236`).
- Added PIN, color, file upload, rating, calendar, tags, slider and rich-text controls.
- Added date ranges, configurable icons, `clearOnHide`, `allOf` handling and richer array support.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Preserved partially typed years and object data, blocked self-referencing schema recursion and
  avoided stale menu listeners during subtree unmounts.

### ⚡ Performance

- Reduced object renderer work and optimized deep `allOf` flattening.

### 📝 Documentation

- Added the VitePress documentation, embedded playground and detailed integration guides.

### 🔧 Internal

- Migrated from Bun to Yarn Classic, replaced ESLint/Prettier with Biome and split regression and
  performance test suites.
